description: Erection of a two storey side, single storey rear, part first floor rear extension and a new front porch following the demolition of the existing timber shed
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [42 001, unnumbered location plan, fire statement, unnumbered block plan 
Received: 13/09/2023
42 002- 01, 42 003- 01
Received: 24/11/2023].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - The side extension at ground floor level hereby permitted shall only be used for the purposed set out on the plans hereby approved and shall not be used as habitable accommodation
Condition : 5 - The single storey rear extension roof shall not be used as a terrace or for any other reason than maintenance.
